chunks: Ahmad narrated from Ali ibn al-Nu'man from Saeed al-A'raj who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the one in Ihram who has a fracture; does he treat it or bind it with a cloth? He said: Yes. And similarly, the ulcer that is on the body.

key_terms.إِحْرَام: The state of consecration for Hajj or Umrah
key_terms.عَصَبَ: To bind or wrap with a bandage

ai.seo_question: Can a person in Ihram treat and bandage a fracture or wound?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the prohibition on covering the body in Ihram is not absolute, permitting the medical treatment and bandaging of injuries like fractures or ulcers. This ruling underscores the principle of *darura* (necessity) in Shia jurisprudence, ensuring that the pilgrim’s health is preserved without invalidating the ritual state. It serves as a foundational text for understanding the flexibility of Ihram regulations when physical harm is involved.
